name: Social Media Manager
tagline: Learns your posting voice from history, drafts when something ships, you publish
description: Studies your posting history to pick up how you actually write, drafts a post whenever there is something worth announcing, and parks it for you to publish. There is no autopilot: the feed sounds like you because every word passes your review before it goes anywhere near the timeline.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
